_comment: Hand-labeled prompt corpus for Phase 3's discoverability baseline. Each prompt is labeled with the shape it SHOULD route to per rules/skill-routing-table.md's 15 GOA shapes, or 'none' where no shape genuinely applies. This measures routing precision/recall -- NOT a raw 'was the genius agent file read' count, which proves nothing about correctness (plan Phase 3).

prompts.text: Should the retry logic live inside the payment client library or in every caller? We keep duplicating it.
prompts.label: boundary-design

prompts.text: The team wants to know whether shipping the new caching layer actually caused the latency drop, or if traffic just dropped that week.
prompts.label: causal-audit

prompts.text: We're about to greenlight a six-month rewrite based on one engineer's gut feeling that the old system is unmaintainable -- can we sanity check the decision before committing?
prompts.label: decision-bias-check

prompts.text: Nobody has measured how many concurrent users the new notification service needs to support at launch. Marketing wants a number today.
prompts.label: estimation

prompts.text: Three benchmark papers report contradictory numbers for the same retrieval method on the same dataset -- which one should we trust for our design doc?
prompts.label: evidence-synthesis
